CREATE TABLE "public"."jobPreference" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "employmentTypes" text[] NOT NULL,
  "excludedKeywords" text[] NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "locations" text[] NOT NULL,
  "minimumMatchScore" int4 DEFAULT 50 NOT NULL,
  "targetRoles" text[] NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "jobPreference_employmentTypes_elem_not_null_15e27405" CHECK (array_position("employmentTypes", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "jobPreference_excludedKeywords_elem_not_null_4947c98d" CHECK (array_position("excludedKeywords", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "jobPreference_locations_elem_not_null_35aec250" CHECK (array_position("locations", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "jobPreference_targetRoles_elem_not_null_e2f5bf9a" CHECK (array_position("targetRoles", NULL) IS NULL)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."skill" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expertise" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "skill_expertise_check_5ed1c8aa" CHECK ("expertise" IN ('BEGINNER', 'INTERMEDIATE', 'ADVANCED', 'EXPERT'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."userProfile" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "firstName" text NOT NULL,
  "headline" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "lastName" text NOT NULL,
  "summary" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "yearsOfExperience" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
